rules.statement: A mortgagee who fails to provide an address for service under section 644 of the Civil Procedure Code and obtains a hypothecary decree against the mortgagor cannot subsequently bring another action against a subsequent grantees or incumbrancers claiming a declaration that the property is chargeable with the mortgage debt.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am of opinion that the view taken by Lascelles C.J. in Ramanathan Chetty v. Cassim 2 as to the intention of the Legislature in enacting chapter XLVI. of the Code is the correct view. The action under chapter XLVI. was intended to provide one action only 'to realize moneys due or secured upon mortgage,' and to do away with the multiplicity of suits."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 644 of the Civil Procedure Code
